description: This file defines a Perl package for a ResultSet class related to email blacklist management within the Coocook schema. It includes methods for adding emails to the blacklist and checking if an email is okay, along with some configuration for blacklist data handling.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::BlacklistEmail
classes.description: A ResultSet class for managing blacklisted emails within the Coocook schema, extending the base ResultSet and including methods for adding and verifying email addresses.

methods.name: add_email
methods.description: Adds a literal email address to the blacklist.

methods.name: is_email_ok
methods.description: Checks if the provided email address is not blacklisted, referencing the blacklist component.

methods.name: _blacklist_default_type
methods.description: Returns the default hashing type used for blacklist entries, 'sha256_b64'.

methods.name: _blacklist_type_column
methods.description: Returns the column name used to store the email type in the blacklist, 'email_type'.

methods.name: _blacklist_value_column
methods.description: Returns the column name used to store the email hash or value, 'email_fc'.
